name: agent.py
summary: Implements the LangGraph chat agent that routes each query to RAG or a direct LLM/search path, keeps in-memory session history, and indexes PDF text in per-user FAISS stores.

name: client.py
summary: Python HTTP client for the FastAPI backend, covering health checks, model listing, chat sessions, document upload, retrieval, and web search.

name: config.py
summary: Central runtime configuration that loads environment variables and defines paths, API keys, model catalogs, RAG chunking and retrieval settings, and agent modes.

name: embeddings.py
summary: Provides a shared embeddings adapter that prefers Cohere and falls back to Google Gemini embeddings when Cohere is unavailable or fails.

name: retriever.py
summary: Chunks uploaded document pages into FAISS records and retrieves them with an initial vector search followed by Cohere reranking.

name: vector_store.py
summary: Persists one FAISS index per user on disk and exposes load, document upsert, and unique source-filename listing.

name: database.py
summary: SQLAlchemy engine, session factory, and declarative Base for the chatbot backend. Provides the FastAPI session dependency and creates tables at startup, enabling SQLite multi-thread access when DATABASE_URL is a SQLite path.

name: main.py
summary: FastAPI application that exposes session, message, document, RAG retrieval, and web-search routes and serves the static single-page app. A lifespan hook creates database tables on startup, and CORS is configured from backend settings.

name: GET /ping
summary: Keepalive route handled by ping for free-tier uptime monitors.

name: GET /health
summary: Health route handled by health_check. Returns HealthResponse with database, Cohere, and Tavily status.

name: GET /models
summary: Model catalog route handled by get_models. Returns the configured LLM list grouped by provider.

name: GET /sessions
summary: Session list route handled by list_sessions. Returns SessionSummary rows for a user_id query parameter.

name: POST /sessions
summary: Session creation route handled by create_session. Accepts SessionCreate and returns the new SessionSchema with HTTP 201.

name: GET /sessions/{session_id}
summary: Session detail route handled by get_session. Returns one session plus its full message history.

name: PATCH /sessions/{session_id}
summary: Session update route handled by update_session. Accepts SessionUpdate for title, model, and mode.

name: DELETE /sessions/{session_id}
summary: Session deletion route handled by delete_session. Responds with HTTP 204 after removing the session and its messages.

name: POST /sessions/{session_id}/messages
summary: Message append route handled by save_message. Accepts MessageCreate and returns the stored MessageSchema with HTTP 201.

name: POST /upload
summary: Document ingestion route handled by upload_document. Accepts a file upload or a URL and returns UploadResponse after indexing.

name: GET /documents
summary: Indexed-document list route handled by list_documents. Returns DocumentSchema rows for a user.

name: POST /retrieve
summary: Hybrid RAG route handled by retrieve_endpoint. Accepts RetrieveRequest and returns RetrieveResponse chunks from FAISS plus Cohere reranking.

name: POST /search
summary: Web search route handled by search_endpoint. Accepts SearchRequest and returns a Tavily SearchResponse.

name: GET /
summary: SPA entry route handled by serve_spa. Returns the frontend index.html file.

name: api.py
summary: Pydantic request and response schemas for sessions, messages, document upload, RAG retrieval, web search, and health checks.

name: db.py
summary: SQLAlchemy ORM models for chat sessions, messages, and indexed documents, stored in the sessions, messages, and documents tables.

name: parser.py
summary: Multi-format document parser that turns PDF, DOCX, CSV, Excel, plain text, and web URLs into page dictionaries for indexing.

name: search.py
summary: Tavily web search service that runs a single query, merges several queries with URL deduplication, and expands a question into a few focused sub-queries.

name: .env.example
summary: Environment template listing Groq, Tavily, Cohere, and optional LLM API keys plus server host, CORS origins, and the SQLite database URL loaded at startup.

name: Procfile
summary: Render and Railway process declaration that starts the FastAPI app with uvicorn, binding to the platform-assigned port.

name: README.md
summary: Getting-started guide for the RAG chatbot covering project layout, local setup, environment variables, FastAPI endpoints, and the LangGraph router-to-agent workflow.

name: requirements.txt
summary: Python package list for the FastAPI server, LangChain and LangGraph providers, FAISS retrieval, PDF and document parsing, and SQLAlchemy persistence.

name: animations.css
summary: Motion stylesheet for the static chatbot SPA: keyframe animations and utility classes for fades, slides, skeletons, the streaming cursor, spinners, and progress fills. Honors prefers-reduced-motion and is linked from frontend/index.html, reusing color and radius tokens from main.css.

name: components.css
summary: Component stylesheet for the chatbot UI, covering buttons, inputs, session items, messages, thought steps, citations, code blocks, the input dock, modals, the welcome screen, and upload controls. Loaded by frontend/index.html and styled with design tokens from main.css plus motion classes from animations.css.

name: main.css
summary: Foundation stylesheet that defines the dark-by-default design tokens, light-theme overrides, app-shell layout (sidebar, top bar, chat area, input dock), typography, and the mobile breakpoint. Linked first from frontend/index.html so animations.css and components.css can reuse its custom properties.

name: devcontainer.json
summary: Dev Container spec for a Python 3.11 image that installs project requirements and Streamlit, forwards FastAPI on port 8000 and Streamlit on 8501, and starts the Streamlit UI with frontend/app.py when the container attaches.

name: config.json
summary: Understand Anything output-language configuration. It sets outputLanguage to en so generated graph text is written in English.

name: Pipfile
summary: Pipenv dependency manifest that pins Python 3.13 and leaves both the packages and dev-packages sections empty, so it does not currently declare installable project dependencies.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker that makes backend importable as a Python package. It does not re-export the FastAPI app or other submodules.

name: models.py
summary: Legacy Pydantic models for an earlier chat API: chat requests and responses, history and clear-history payloads, a user-documents request, and a health payload. It is a sibling of the backend.models package and is not re-exported by backend/models/__init__.py.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker for backend.models. It does not re-export api.py, db.py, or the legacy backend/models.py module.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker for the backend RAG package. Retrieval and embedding modules live beside it and are not re-exported here.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker for backend services such as document parsing, the vector store, and web search. It does not re-export those modules.

name: .gitkeep
summary: Empty placeholder that keeps the data directory under version control when no runtime documents or indexes are committed.

name: __init__.py
summary: Empty package marker for the frontend directory. The Streamlit entry point is frontend/app.py, which this file does not import.

name: app.py
summary: Streamlit UI for the RAG chatbot. It keeps session state, renders chat and document controls, and calls the FastAPI backend over HTTP at BACKEND_URL (default http://localhost:8000) for chat, history, PDF upload, and document listing.

name: index.html
summary: Static shell for the AI Assistant Pro single-page app. It lays out the chat, sidebar, upload, and citation UI, links the three local stylesheets, and loads the browser scripts ending with frontend/js/app.js.

name: api.js
summary: Browser REST client exposed as window.API. It calls the FastAPI backend for sessions, messages, document upload and listing, RAG retrieve, web search, and health, using window.CONFIG.BACKEND_URL when set.

name: app.js
summary: SPA orchestrator that wires the chat UI, keeps session and mode state, and runs the send pipeline: persist the user message, retrieve RAG chunks, optionally search the web, then stream a Puter.js completion.

name: chat.js
summary: Chat transcript renderer exposed as window.Chat. It builds user and assistant bubbles, streams tokens with thought steps and citation cards, and restores prior session history.

name: config.example.js
summary: Sample window.CONFIG for the static SPA. BACKEND_URL is the Python API origin consumed by api.js; PUTER_TOKEN is a placeholder for Puter.js model access. The page loads /js/config.js, not this example.

name: puter_client.js
summary: window.PuterClient wrapper around puter.ai.chat. It streams or returns a full completion and builds mode-specific system prompts that inject RAG excerpts and web search results.

name: ui.js
summary: window.UI helpers for theme, sidebar, session and document lists, toasts, citation and URL modals, and the file drop overlay used by the static chat page.

name: utils.js
summary: window.Utils helpers for markdown rendering with citation badges, syntax highlighting and copy buttons, HTML escaping, timestamps, date groups, and ids.
